'''Mekith''' was a<ref name="Wizards" /> tiny<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]],<ref name="Wizards" /> located in [[Sector 5/Legends|Sector 5]]<ref name="SOL" /> of the [[Deep Core]]. It occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Prak]] and had a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Mekith featured a rocky surface and a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] environment.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mekith was first mentioned in "[[Byss and the Deep Core]], Part 3: Prakith," the third entry in the [[Planet Hoppers]] ''[[Byss and the Deep Core]]'' article series, written by [[Rodney Thompson]] and published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[April 21]], [[2005]].<ref name="Wizards" /> The planet's first appearance was in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]],<ref name="DoE" /> which was published on [[December 8]], [[2009]].<ref name="SWBU">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090219.html|text=Book Update: ''Deathtroopers'' and Darth Bane}}</ref> The reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> published on [[August 18]], 2009,<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> placed the Prakith [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Mekith, in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
